scope: Passage-backed relationships involving these 20 Greek catalog entries. This is not a complete biography, quotation, variant, or traffic review.
openQuestions: Zeus as father of Hephaestus remains a disputed variant; the supported Hera parent edge is not evidence for Zeus paternity.
Athena’s second primarySources passage belongs to Iliad 1.207–211; the existing translation wording remains unverified.
Maternal catalog entries such as Leto, Maia, Metis, and Semele are still absent; their omitted graph edges must not be mistaken for absence in the sources.
Other relationships and biographies on these entries have not been comprehensively verified.
